run_chat_completion: run a chat completion request through the LiteLLM proxy router with model routing and streaming support
run_embeddings: run an embeddings request through the LiteLLM proxy with token array input decoding for langchain integration
run_audio_speech: run text-to-speech audio generation through the LiteLLM proxy with streaming chunk response
run_token_counter: run token counting for a model using provider-specific or local tokenizer fallback
run_model_cost_map_reload: run manual reload of the LiteLLM model cost map from the remote pricing source
build_proxy_config: build a ProxyConfig instance that loads and manages YAML and database configuration for the LiteLLM proxy
build_proxy_startup_event: build a ProxyStartupEvent handler that initializes logging, scheduler jobs, health checks, and DB connections on proxy startup
test_background_health_check: test the background health check loop that periodically pings model endpoints and updates router health state
test_spend_counters: test the spend counter system that tracks per-key, per-team, and per-user costs with Redis-backed cross-pod synchronization
test_config_update: test updating proxy configuration through the config management endpoints with DB-backed settings persistence
